text: {"lessons":["A sale should reflect a changed outlook, not discomfort with a loss; selling Stock B at a loss and buying it back later at a higher price shows the cost of acting without a consistent thesis.","Avoid repeatedly switching into and out of positions. Before each trade, define the reason, expected time horizon, and conditions that would change the decision.","Size new positions deliberately and preserve diversification: adding to stocks while trimming a winner can shift risk substantially, so check the whole portfolio against the long-term goal of beating the market."]}
